pages.text: The chronicle contains 56 historical events and 11 main-story milestones. The in-game chronicle screen displays the records you have unlocked.
pages.title: Chronicle Primer

pages.text: Qi Refining: 13 layers / lifespan 120$(br)Foundation Establishment: 4 stages / lifespan 250$(br)Core Formation: 3 stages / lifespan 600$(br)Nascent Soul: 3 stages / lifespan 1200$(br)Deity Transformation: 3 stages / lifespan 2500$(br)Void Refinement: 3 stages / lifespan 5000$(br)Body Integration: 3 stages / lifespan 10000$(br)Mahayana: 3 stages / lifespan 100000$(br)Tribulation Transcendence: 1 stage / no fixed lifespan cap
pages.title: Realm and Lifespan Chart

pages.text: $(l)The Five Realms Divide$() - The laws of the Mortal Realm, Spirit Realm, Netherworld, Ancient Demon Realm, and Immortal Realm become fixed.$(br)$(l)Fall of the True Spirits$() - Mighty True Spirits perish, their remains becoming secret realms such as the Nether River and Guanghan fragments.$(br)$(l)Collapse of the Asura Realm$() - The realm shatters, and fragments sometimes appear as Lesser Asura Realms.$(br)$(l)The Sacred Bird Descends$() - The Mulan beast clans begin worshiping the Azure Peacock lineage.$(br)$(l)Tianlan Sacred Beast Pact$() - The Tuwu clans establish the Sacred Beast Seal and formalize their ancestral feud with Mulan.$(br)$(l)Kunwu Spirit Mountain at Its Height$() - The foremost spirit mountain of the Mortal Realm hosts Daoist, Buddhist, Confucian, and demonic traditions.
pages.title: Event Excerpt 1

pages.text: $(l)Rise of Stone-Spirit Puppetry$() - Beast souls are sealed in statues at the height of ancient puppet craft.$(br)$(l)Thousand Bamboo Patriarch's Revelation$() - Divine Lord Great Development creates the Great Development Art and mechanical puppetry.$(br)$(l)The Void Palace Is Built$() - Ancient cultivators of the Chaotic Star Sea sink a jade palace into the void.$(br)$(l)Retreat to the Scarlet Forbidden Land$() - Ancient cultivators of Yue enter seclusion there and pass away.$(br)$(l)First Human-Demon War$() - Kunwu Mountain clashes with a demon army and the spirit mountain is damaged.$(br)$(l)Flourishing of the Nascent-Nurturing Formula$() - This Deity Transformation aid is later lost with its sect.
pages.title: Event Excerpt 2

pages.text: $(l)Ancient Demon Realm Rift Opens$() - Ancient demons invade the Mortal Realm until upper-realm forces help seal the breach.$(br)$(l)Damage to the Spirit Veins$() - Demonic qi pollutes the veins and permanently degrades the environment.$(br)$(l)Deity Transformation Limit Falls$() - Reaching the middle and late stages becomes exceedingly difficult in the Mortal Realm.$(br)$(l)Battle of Devilfall Valley$() - Great demonic cultivators clash through formations, creating the valley.$(br)$(l)Pact of the Demon-Sealing Formation$() - The major rifts, though not every breach, are sealed.$(br)$(l)Formation of the Devil-Gold Mountains$() - A primordial demonic cultivator self-destructs and leaves behind a demon-tainted range.
